item.title: FishTrippers Village Concierto 280
item.excerpt:
The Concierto 280 is a large presence floating stickbait developed by SOHO and Trippers Japan. This 280mm 143g stickbait has been created with angler ease of use at the forefront of its creation. Although it is a large lure the flat side make it easy to work through the water cutting through with minimal effort. The action is more of an irregular darting motion that creates splashes and flashes above and below the surface of the water. Working the lure slow with long sweeps will cause a more predictable darting S-Shape action while short aggressive chops will really get the irregular darting action some desire. 

Being a big presence lure the Concierto 280 is ideal for targeting large GT's, large kingfish, dogtooth tuna, bluefin tuna, yellowfin tuna and monster reef species.

Made in Japan!

  • Length 280 mm

  • Gr. 143

prevItem.title: Kikuchi Craft Bubble Swimmer
prevItem.excerpt:
The bubble swimmer is a renowned lure in offshore big game fishing, especially tuna casting.
Its centrally concentrated weight balance provides exceptional casting distance, allowing anglers to approach promising targets at great distances.
Proven effective in countless fields both domestically and internationally, including the magnificent bluefin tuna of Oma, it has established itself as a pioneer in the recent popper boom in tuna casting.

The basic action of the BUBBLE SWIMMER is "stop and go."
It breaks the water's surface, moving with small bubbles, and then instantly comes to a stop. This contrast between movement and stillness is the key to awakening the hunting instincts of the target fish.
In particular, the long pauses provide an effective approach for wary big game fish. To maximize its potential, we recommend pairing it with a rod that has a flexible tip.

  • Length 210 mm

  • Gr.71

  • Color Sardine

nextItem.title: Jumprize Lalapen
nextItem.excerpt:
LALAPEN is a diving pencil designed exclusively for plug casting games targeting large bluefish and tuna.
In the past, it has been difficult to combine response, action, body strength, and flight distance with ABS materials due to specific gravity issues.
However, with the combination of more than two years of thorough actual fishing tests and cutting-edge development technology, the ultimate diving pencil that far exceeds the limits of ABS materials has been completed. Not only offshore, but also in blue casting games from the shore, which has become popular in recent years. The highest level of the shore game's harsh fishing that can never be avoided with lure loss and damage. Body strength and durability are essential for this game, and only those who can attack vigorously without hesitation without fear of damage or lost can encounter large blue things.
